verdict.rationale: Brave Search API covers the whole search, extract and synthesize flow under one API. The LLM Context endpoint returns pre-extracted, token-budgeted page content with no scraping. The Answers endpoint offers a research mode that runs "iterative deep research instead of a single search" and grounds answers across multiple searches, and the official MCP server exposes search, LLM context and summarization tools to agents. Research mode requires streaming and does not support inline citations, and the evidence describes its multi-step behavior only thinly. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of research-mode iteration and its controls, inline citations in research mode, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent run a multi-step research flow — search, extract contents, and synthesize — through one API
